component-o.description-s: Keystone miniature SMT test point (surface mount), 3.0 x 1.6 x 1.8 mm (L x W x H) phosphor bronze loop, silver plate, tape and reel; pad 3.8 x 2.0 mm (Keystone catalog p.55). A single surface-mount loop for probes, clips and hooks on one face, so a board placed on both faces keeps the other side free; its net is the design's.
